about: What enforces each rule, which pillars it serves and which parts it touches. Keyed by RULES.md Rule ID, by agents:<AGENTS.md key>, or by candidate:<id> for rules proposed in the HAX Scheduled Background Jobs Plan that aren't written into RULES.md or AGENTS.md yet. enforced_by names tiles in the Quality control web; build_rules.py drops any that no longer exist there, so a rule whose check goes away turns back into a gap. Every enforcement link here was checked against the workflow or lint config that does it.

40983ddf-40b7-4a5e-a600-8f9fcb58da83.how: Not enforced yet: no check renders elements without HAX loaded. A gap to automate.

nJF4SY.how: ESLint no-restricted-syntax (ChainExpression) in webcomponents; advisory in CI, blocking in yarn precheck before push.

CEHsAz.how: ESLint no-restricted-globals (window) in webcomponents; advisory in CI, blocking in yarn precheck.

7CPveF.how: The color-contrast gate fails a PR when a touched element's demo falls below WCAG AA contrast in light or dark mode; element test suites include axe checks where an element has tests; the weekly sweep checks every demo. Other accessibility checks are not a blocking gate.

13166d.how: Render benchmarks run on PRs and report without failing.

4a7c9e.how: knip reports unlisted and unused dependencies (report only).

rVsCTS.how: The HAXSchema check fails a webcomponents pull request when a changed element's haxProperties don't validate or don't match what it declares; known problems are baselined and the baseline only shrinks.

agents:Formatting.how: Prettier format check: fails the PR in create and haxcms-nodejs, reports only in webcomponents.

agents:Component Security.how: CodeQL flags unsanitized input flowing into the DOM.

candidate:version_hidden.how: haxcms-nodejs test/unit/version-not-exposed-unauthenticated.test.cjs runs in its unit tests (merged in haxcms-nodejs#189); haxcms-php has no matching test yet.

34ef39a0.how: The dark-motion check opens each changed element's demo in light and dark with reduced motion on, and fails the pull request on a new failure.

agents:Unbundled Approach.how: Partly, and only as a report: the size report measures what an unbundled page downloads for each changed element, without failing the pull request.

candidates.title: Element front-end APIs never change
candidates.text: Attributes, usage and existing labels of authorable elements never change, so all content ever made keeps working. Visual and language-support improvements are fine.

candidates.title: Content elements don't require the full DDD stack
candidates.text: Content-level elements work without loading the whole DDD design system.

candidates.title: User-authored links are always respected
candidates.text: Links an author writes (http included) are kept as written.

candidates.title: The HAX version is never shown to unauthenticated users
candidates.text: No version number reaches anyone who isn't logged in.

candidates.title: No native prompt or confirm dialogs
candidates.text: Confirmation steps are built into the page, never the browser's prompt(), confirm() or alert().

candidates.title: HAX imports use explicit .js paths
candidates.text: Our own elements are imported with the full .js file path, since the server can't load extensionless paths.

candidates.title: DDD layers: content scale, HAX UI admin style, instructional element blueprint
candidates.text: Each surface uses its DDD layer: content scale for what readers see, the denser HAX UI style for admin surfaces, and the instructional element blueprint for activities.

candidates.title: xAPI conformance and stable answer keys
candidates.text: Learning activities send conformant xAPI statements, and answer keys stay stable so results stay comparable.

candidates.title: Green for correct, purple for incorrect
candidates.text: Correct is green and incorrect is purple, never red, for decisions with consequences.
